correctness.rationale: Unit facet normals have Gram G=((d+1)/d)I-(1/d)J for every k<=d, with inverse (d/(d+1))I+d/((d+1)(d-k+1))J and determinant g. For y_i=<u_i,x>-1>=0 and orthogonal z, |x|²=rho²+2a sum(y)+y^TG^-1 y+|z|² with rho²=dk/(d-k+1), a=d/(d-k+1); Jacobian g^-1/2. Integrating the z-ball yields the exact orthant k-dimensional integral, valid with exponent zero interpreted as an indicator for k=d. Rescaling y by excess T=t²-rho² and dominated convergence over the standard simplex gives power (d+k)/2 and exact coefficient pi^((d-k)/2)(2rho)^((d+k)/2)/[(2a)^k sqrt(g) Gamma((d+k)/2+1)]. The k=d onset is outside the simplex vertex radius d but is a genuine term of global inclusion-exclusion, whose contributions cancel to give CDF1 for t>=d. The d+1-fold exterior is empty since sum normals=0. Independent Gram inverses, determinants, thresholds d=3..9 and the d3,k1 spherical cap coefficient pi were verified.
residual_risks: The all-k onset law is for prescribed facet-exterior intersections in ambient ball, not a single nonanalytic singularity of the fully canceled CDF at t=d.
